FN-B6ET444-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 118
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 118 as introduced provides for the continuance of the State Board of Chiropractic
Examiners until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
Page 1

This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
